name: Pangasinan Marathon 32KM Beyond 21 2026
short_description: Pangasinan Marathon 32KM Beyond 21 is on Sunday 13 December 2026 at the Capitol Compound in Lingayen, Pangasinan, with 32 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races.
ai_summary: Pangasinan Marathon 32KM Beyond 21 is held on Sunday 13 December 2026 at the Capitol Compound, Barangay Poblacion, in Lingayen, Pangasinan, with the start listed at 4:00 am. Its headline race is 32 km, with 21 km, 10 km and 5 km options priced from PHP 1,099 to PHP 2,299. The organiser is UR Events Management.

faqs.question: When is Pangasinan Marathon 32KM Beyond 21?
faqs.answer: The race is on Sunday 13 December 2026, with the start listed at 4:00 am Philippine time on the MyRunTime entry page. Online registration for every category closes on 5 December 2026. Gun times for each distance and cut-off times have not been published yet.

faqs.question: What distances are offered?
faqs.answer: As the name says, the main race goes beyond the half marathon to 32 km, aimed at runners building towards a full marathon. There are also 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Fees are PHP 2,299 for 32 km, PHP 1,999 for 21 km, PHP 1,499 for 10 km and PHP 1,099 for 5 km.

faqs.question: Where is it held?
faqs.answer: Start and finish are at the Provincial Capitol Compound in Barangay Poblacion, Lingayen, the provincial capital of Pangasinan on the Lingayen Gulf coast. It is a different event from the Pangasinan Half Marathon, which was held in Lingayen in September 2026.
